tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: List Loopr leveraged strategies with APY, leverage bounds, deposit/borrow tokens and TVL. Filter by chain, deposit asset or protocol.

tools.name: get_strategy
tools.description: Get one strategy. Pass depositToken/borrowToken when several strategies share a strategyId on the same chain.

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: List an owner EOA's Loopr positions with health, leverage and PnL. Requires chainId or chainIds. Pass positionAddress (with chainId, not chainIds) to fetch a single position: it returns `{ position, errors, catalogUnavailable }`, and a null `position` with `errors` rows means the chain could not be

tools.name: get_sca_account
tools.description: Derive the smart contract account (SCA) that holds Loopr positions for an EOA. Deterministic; the same on every chain.

tools.name: quote_open
tools.description: Quote opening a leveraged position: expected collateral, debt, health factor and liquidation price. Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

tools.name: quote_adjust
tools.description: Quote adding collateral ('push', requires leverage) or withdrawing it ('pull'). Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

tools.name: quote_borrow
tools.description: Quote borrowing more against a position. Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

tools.name: quote_repay
tools.description: Quote repaying debt. 'auto' repays from collateral via a flash-loan swap and requires slippage; 'manual' repays from the wallet. Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

tools.name: quote_claim
tools.description: Quote claiming rewards. 'send' pays them to the owner; 'compound' swaps them into the position and requires slippage. The returned `rewards` feed build_claim. Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

tools.name: quote_close
tools.description: Quote closing a position in full. Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

tools.name: build_open
tools.description: Build the steps that open a leveraged position. Returns UNSIGNED transaction steps for the owner to sign in order; this server never holds keys or sends transactions. tools.name: build_adjust
tools.description: Build the steps that add collateral ('push': requires collateralToken, amount, borrowToken, leverage) or withdraw it ('pull': requires token, tokenOut, and exactly one of withdrawAmount or withdrawAll). tools.name: build_repay
tools.description: Build the steps that repay debt. 'auto' requires slippage; 'manual' repays from the owner's wallet.
